notes.title: Summer Sale with 75% OFF on all DLCs
notes.content:
[img] http://s7.hostingkartinok.com/uploads/images/2015/06/57b22470db71afbf4ed84b972f36e981.jpg [/img]
Wow! This summer is getting really hot, but what's even hotter - the Summer Sale is on now!
We wanna make sure you get the most out of the biggest event ever. Please, learn more about this Sale of the century:	
[list]
 [*]The Sale starts today, June 11, at 10 AM Pacific;	
 [*]Discounts will be 75% per DLC (all My Lands DLCs are included);	
 [*]The Sale ends June 22, at 10 AM Pacific.
[/list]
Now you know, the rest is up to you. Mark it on your calendar and hurry up to grab the best My Lands DLCs with 75% OFF.

Good luck and enjoy the summer!

notes.title: Be ready for update in My Lands this Thursday!
notes.content:
Hey strategy fans!

We are happy to announce the first update to our Steam community!
Be ready for update this Thursday [b](2nd October)[/b] and meet new stuff that you will definitely like.

Update will include the following:
[list]
[*] Fixes of reported issues in payment process.
[*] Improvements of a game client interface and optimization of its performance.
[*] Support of new language - Norwegian. Hei!
[/list]

Stay tuned and follow [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/290730]“My Lands”[/url] updates
